findings: The stated controls are directionally sound: exact-instrument history, independent per-symbol research, conservative same-bar stop handling, untouched FINAL data, and deterministic replay.

Data integrity cannot be verified from the supplied summary because no symbol manifest, venue/instrument identifiers, raw-data hashes, timestamps, timezone rules, candle-construction specification, missing/duplicate-bar report, or fallback splice audit is provided.
The DEV/VALIDATION/FINAL boundaries are incomplete. FINAL is described only as 'early-August onward'; immutable exact timestamps and a knowledge cutoff must be fixed before research begins.

OKX-first fallback continuity requires explicit rules for venue changes, symbol mapping, quote currency, contract type, price scaling, timestamp alignment, overlap reconciliation, and forbidden synthetic gap filling.

The coordinate search is exposed to multiple-testing and selection bias across family, hour, and entry geometry. Search bounds, candidate counts, tie-breaking, minimum sample sizes, and validation acceptance rules are unspecified.

The contract requires 1..3 eligible-day executions, but deterministic definitions for eligible day, execution ordering, simultaneous signals, position overlap, daily caps, session boundaries, fees, spread, slippage, and rejected/unfilled orders are absent.
Conservative same-bar SL is insufficient by itself: deterministic handling is also needed when entry, stop, and target are all touched within one bar, as well as gaps and price increments.

Earlier V64/V69/V73 results are correctly labeled exposed development evidence, but their known-through date of 2026-07-31 creates contamination risk unless FINAL begins strictly after all data and decisions observable to those studies.
review.proposal: Freeze a 94-row symbol registry before tuning, containing canonical instrument and venue IDs, asset class, timezone, tick/lot size, source priority, requested and received ranges, and raw-file hashes. Produce automated integrity reports for duplicates, missing intervals, nonmonotonic timestamps, invalid OHLC, outliers, source transitions, and fallback overlap discrepancies; fail closed rather than silently deleting eligible days. Pre-register immutable DEV, VALIDATION, and FINAL timestamp boundaries, with FINAL strictly beyond 2026-07-31 and beyond every legacy decision cutoff. Keep FINAL inaccessible until all code, parameters, symbol rules, and replay hashes are frozen. For each symbol independently, enumerate a finite predeclared grid for H1 family, hour, and entry geometry; cap candidate count, specify deterministic tie-breaking, and require minimum eligible days/trades plus the 1..3 daily-execution rule. Select on DEV only and permit bounded confirmation on VALIDATION without retuning; apply a predeclared multiplicity or stability control such as nested walk-forward consistency, neighborhood robustness, or family-wise false-discovery limits. Specify execution semantics completely, including session/day boundaries, signal timing, next-tradable-price entry, spread, fees, slippage, tick rounding, overlap, gaps, and worst-case same-bar ordering. Run deterministic replay from immutable inputs and emit per-symbol manifests, event logs, exclusion reason codes, parameter hashes, and aggregate reconciliation totals. Evaluate RR 1 and RR 2 separately against at least 80% win rate and positive net expectancy; do not pool symbols, delete failures, or claim performance until untouched FINAL replay completes.
